storms.name: flaky-pay
storms.title: payment endpoint fails twice, then works
storms.expect: When POST /api/pay fails with a temporary error (HTTP 503) the app must retry with backoff (at least 3 attempts) and finish the purchase. The user must end on the text "Order confirmed".

baseline.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the page shows the text 'Order confirmed'"

tries.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the page shows the text 'Order confirmed'"

agent.message: I changed `pay()` in `demo/shop/server.mjs` to retry `POST /api/pay` on a 503, up to 5 attempts with exponential backoff (300 ms, 600 ms, and so on). It shows "Order confirmed" once a retry succeeds, and "Payment failed" if every attempt fails. I haven't run the tests or the Kane journey.

storms.name: lost-response
storms.title: payment goes through but the answer never arrives
storms.expect: When POST /api/pay is processed by the server but the response is lost, a retry or a second click must never create a second order. Use an idempotency key: the browser sends one key per purchase (header Idempotency-Key) and the server returns the same order for the same key. The user must see "Order confirmed" and the orders page must show exactly "Orders: 1".

baseline.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "Verify the page shows exactly the text 'Orders: 1'"

tries.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the page shows exactly the text 'Orders: 1'"

agent.message: I changed `demo/shop/server.mjs` so each purchase sends one `Idempotency-Key` header with `/api/pay`, and the server now returns the same order for a repeated key instead of creating a second one. The browser also retries `/api/pay` when the connection drops, using the same key. I haven't run the shop or the storm test, so this is untested.

storms.name: pay-down
storms.title: payment is down for good
storms.expect: When POST /api/pay keeps failing, the app must show a clear message that contains the words "payment is unavailable", must keep the item in the cart (the cart still lists the Mug), and must never show "Order confirmed".

baseline.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "a message containing the words 'payment is unavailable' is visible"

tries.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "a message containing the words 'payment is unavailable' is visible; the item 'Mug' is still listed in the cart"

agent.message: I changed the failed-payment handler in `demo/shop/server.mjs`. It no longer empties the cart, and it now shows "Sorry, payment is unavailable right now. Your cart is saved; please try again." I haven't run the Kane test or a no-fault purchase. The success path wasn't touched, so it should still end with "Order confirmed".

storms.name: slow-cart
storms.title: cart answers after 12 seconds
storms.expect: When GET /api/cart is slow, the checkout page must never be blank. It must show a loading text ("Loading your cart") while it waits, and when the cart fails or times out it must show a message and a "Try again" button. When the cart arrives it must list the Mug.

baseline.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the page is never blank: it must show either the text 'Loading your cart', or the cart listing 'Mug', or an error message with a 'Try again' button"

tries.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "The page is never blank: it must show either the text 'Loading your cart', the cart listing 'Mug', or an error message with a 'Try again' button."

If the cart request fails or times out after 8 seconds, it shows an error message and a "Try again" button that re-runs the load. I haven't run the shop or the Kane flow, so none of this is tested, including that a purchase with no fault

storms.name: html-error
storms.title: product list answers with an HTML error page
storms.expect: When GET /api/products answers 200 with an HTML error page instead of JSON (every time), the page must not be blank. It must show a readable error message (for example "Could not load the shop") and a "Reload" button that fetches the products again.

baseline.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the page shows at least one visible heading, line of text or button"

tries.reason: After 10 seconds, the page has no visible content, indicating a completely white page.

agent.message: I changed `boot()` in `demo/shop/server.mjs` so a failed or non-JSON `/api/products` response shows "Could not load the shop" and a "Reload" button that calls `boot()` again. I haven't run the browser test or a no-fault purchase. The success path is unchanged, so a purchase should still end with "Order confirmed".
